label: def:mass-energy
title: Mass--energy equivalence from the causal-cone Legendre transform ($\mathfrak{E} = \mathfrak{m} \cdot c_q^2$)
html:
Proposition (conditional on the braid-boost inertial equivalence). Part 1 is unconditional; part 2 holds under that conjecture.

Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) be an archimedean quantum observable universe over \mathbb{R} with substrate parameter q > 1 and causal-cone speed c_q = q^{-1}/\hbar_q = 1/(q-1) (speed of light).

  1. For a relativistic worldline of kinematic inertia m_{\mathrm{in}} \in \mathbb{R} moving at sub-cone velocity |v| < c_q with Lagrangian L(v) = -m_{\mathrm{in}}\,c_q\sqrt{c_q^2 - v^2} and conjugate momentum p(v) = \partial L/\partial v = m_{\mathrm{in}}\,c_q\,v / \sqrt{c_q^2 - v^2}, the Legendre transform (categorical Hamiltonian) gives 
      E(v)
  = p(v)\,v - L(v)
  = \frac{m_{\mathrm{in}}\,c_q^2}{\sqrt{1 - v^2/c_q^2}},
  \qquad
  E(v)^2 - p(v)^2\,c_q^2 = \bigl(m_{\mathrm{in}}\,c_q^2\bigr)^2,
    with rest-frame energy E(0) = m_{\mathrm{in}}\,c_q^2 = m_{\mathrm{in}}/(q - 1)^2 and classical Galilean divergence c_q^2 \to \infty as q \to 1.
  2. Conditional on boost-inertial equivalence equating the kinematic worldline inertia m_{\mathrm{in}}(\beta) of a braid class \beta with its static Frobenius--Hopf holonomy mass \mathfrak{m}(\beta) (mass identity), the rest energy of \beta is 
      \mathfrak{E}(\beta)
  = \mathfrak{m}(\beta) \cdot c_q^2
  = \frac{\mathfrak{m}(\beta)}{(q - 1)^2}.
